Category.name: Spartan
Category.desc: Your body: health, size, camo and movement.

Mod.name: God Mode
Mod.desc: Nothing can hurt or kill you, including kill barriers. Uses HCM's built-in invulnerability.

Mod.name: Permanent Active Camo
Mod.desc: Stay cloaked. In Halo CE the camo is a timed power-up, so toggle again when it fades.

Mod.name: Spartan Size
Mod.desc: Grow into a giant or shrink to Grunt height. 1 is normal. Your hitbox scales too.

Mod.name: Tank Vitality
Mod.desc: Sets your maximum health and shields to this many points and refills them. Revert a checkpoint to undo.

Mod.name: Full Heal
Mod.desc: Refill health and shields to maximum right now.

Mod.name: No Fall Damage
Mod.desc: Drop from any height without dying.

Mod.name: Ghost Protocol
Mod.desc: Enemies ignore you completely. Walk right past a Hunter pair. Works on every player in co-op.

Mod.name: Invisible Body
Mod.desc: Hides your model from the world. Best seen in third person or by your co-op partner.

Mod.name: Vision Mode
Mod.desc: Turns on the unit's vision mode. In ODST this is VISR.

Mod.name: Rocket Jump
Mod.desc: Fires you straight up. Pair with No Fall Damage.

Mod.name: Launch (HCM)
Mod.desc: Launches you using HCM's launch settings (set the direction and power in HCM's main menu).

Mod.name: Teleport Forward (HCM)
Mod.desc: Teleports you using HCM's teleport settings.

Mod.name: Respawn Me
Mod.desc: Kills your Spartan so you respawn. Handy when you're stuck in geometry.

Category.name: Become
Category.desc: Take over other bodies. Hunters included.

Mod.name: Body Swap (Bump Possession)
Mod.desc: Halo CE's hidden developer cheat. Walk into ANY unit (a Hunter, an Elite, a Marine, a Flood form) and you become it. Toggle off to stop swapping.

Mod.name: Summon Every Character
Mod.desc: Spawns one of every character the level has loaded, right in front of you. Then walk into the one you want to be.

Mod.name: Hunter Mode
Mod.desc: Not a true body swap in this game: makes your Spartan Hunter-sized and Hunter-tough, kills fall damage, and puts the Covenant on your side so Hunters fight with you.

Mod.name: Switch Sides
Mod.desc: Make a faction your ally. Pick one and press Apply. Undo breaks the alliance again.

Mod.name: Infinite Ammo
Mod.desc: Reserve ammo never runs out.

Mod.name: Bottomless Clip
Mod.desc: Never reload. Your magazine never empties.

Mod.name: Infinite Everything (Bandanna)
Mod.desc: The Bandanna skull: infinite ammo, grenades and abilities. Shows only if this game has it.

Mod.name: Medusa
Mod.desc: Any enemy you look at dies.

Mod.name: Scarab Gun
Mod.desc: Every weapon you hold fires a Scarab beam.

Mod.name: Double Explosions
Mod.desc: The Boom skull: explosion radius doubled.

Mod.name: Give All Weapons
Mod.desc: Drops every weapon the level has loaded at your feet.

Mod.name: Spawn All Vehicles
Mod.desc: Spawns every vehicle the level has loaded around you.

Mod.name: Spawn Warthog
Mod.desc: A Warthog appears next to you.

Mod.name: All Power-ups
Mod.desc: Spawns camo and overshield power-ups next to you.

Category.name: World
Category.desc: Gravity, time, weather and the look of the level.

Mod.name: Gravity
Mod.desc: 1 is normal. 0.2 is moon gravity: jumps go for miles and grenades float.

Mod.name: Time Warp
Mod.desc: Turns HCM's game-speed control on or off. Set the speed below.

Mod.name: Time Warp Speed
Mod.desc: 0.25 is bullet time, 2 is double speed. Only active while Time Warp is on.

Mod.name: Clear Skies
Mod.desc: Turns off rain, snow and other weather effects.

Mod.name: No Fog
Mod.desc: Removes atmospheric fog so you can see across the whole map.

Mod.name: No Motion Blur
Mod.desc: Turns off camera motion blur.

Mod.name: No Invisible Walls
Mod.desc: Removes the soft ceilings that stop you leaving the play area.

Mod.name: Wireframe World
Mod.desc: Renders the level as a wireframe. Developer debug view.

Mod.name: Field of View Scale
Mod.desc: Engine FOV multiplier. MCC's own FOV setting may override it.

Mod.name: Weapon Model FOV
Mod.desc: Scales the first-person weapon view. Lower shows more of your gun.

Mod.name: Earthquake
Mod.desc: Shakes the camera until you turn it off.

Mod.name: Clean Up Bodies
Mod.desc: Removes corpses and dropped junk to free up the engine.

Mod.name: Freeze All AI
Mod.desc: Every AI stops moving and thinking.

Mod.name: Invincible Allies
Mod.desc: Your Marines and allies cannot die.

Mod.name: Erase All AI
Mod.desc: Deletes every AI on the map. Allies too.

Mod.name: Place AI Squad
Mod.desc: Spawns a squad by its script name, for example a mission's encounter or squad name.

Mod.name: One-Hit Kills
Mod.desc: Every hit you land is lethal.

Mod.name: Checkpoint Now
Mod.desc: Forces a checkpoint right here.

Mod.name: Revert to Checkpoint
Mod.desc: Loads your last checkpoint.

Mod.name: Restart Mission
Mod.desc: Starts the level over, same as the pause menu.

Mod.name: Block Auto Checkpoints
Mod.desc: The game stops making its own checkpoints.

Mod.name: Win Mission
Mod.desc: Ends the level as a win and moves to the next one.

Mod.name: Cinema Bars
Mod.desc: Black cinematic bars for screenshots and clips.

Mod.name: Fade to Black
Mod.desc: Fades the screen to black over one second.

Mod.name: Fade Back In
Mod.desc: Fades the screen back in.

Mod.name: Hide HUD
Mod.desc: Clean screen for screenshots.

Mod.name: Free Camera
Mod.desc: Detaches the camera so you can fly around. Controls are in HCM's main menu.

Mod.name: Hide Crosshair
Mod.desc: Removes the reticle only.

Mod.name: Open Script Console
Mod.desc: Opens HCM's HaloScript console for typing any engine command.

Category.name: Skulls
Category.desc: Every skull this game has, flipped live mid-mission.

Category.name: Halo CE Classic
Category.desc: Bungie's developer cheats, still hidden inside Halo CE.

Mod.name: Jetpack
Mod.desc: Hold jump to fly.

Mod.name: Super Jump
Mod.desc: Jump several stories high.

Mod.name: Infinite Ammo (engine)
Mod.desc: The engine's own infinite ammo cheat.

Mod.name: Bottomless Clip (engine)
Mod.desc: The engine's own bottomless clip cheat.

Mod.name: Medusa (engine)
Mod.desc: The engine's own Medusa: enemies you look at die.

Mod.name: Reflexive Damage
Mod.desc: Damage effects reflect back at the attacker.

Mod.name: Teleport to Free Camera
Mod.desc: Moves Master Chief to wherever HCM's free camera is.

Category.name: Custom
Category.desc: Your own commands. Add more mods to this file to grow this tab.

Mod.name: Run Any Command
Mod.desc: Type any HaloScript command, for example (physics_set_gravity 0.5).
